description: Get year-to-date payroll figures, last run date, and next payment due. Use when user asks about payroll costs, total salary spend, or when the next payroll run is. For a salary, drawings or "what have I paid myself" question read list_employees (the configured salary), this (whether payroll has run) and get_transactions (what left the bank) together: a configured salary with no payroll runs means nothing was paid through payroll, so say that and show what the bank shows.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

tax_year.description: Tax year (e.g. "2025-26"). Defaults to current tax year.

name: get_payroll_summary
title: Get Payroll Summary
